next_action: Keep the preserved stale endpoints until the repaired daemon remains stable; use container GPU profiling only after a causal structured selector clears the analytic quality gate.

hypothesis: A causal selector using only the incoming final-layer MLP state can choose contiguous neuron blocks and preserve dense behavior at no more than 90% execution when trained directly on behavioral reconstruction.
falsification_criterion: Held-out top-1 agreement <0.99, mean KL >=0.01, execution >0.90, or selector metadata eliminates the layer-relative analytic margin.
dataset: 205 unique prompts deduplicated from 300 alternating enterprise synthetic examples
data_split: torch-randperm seed 20261012; 160 train prompts (82 classification, 74 extraction, 4 tool selection) and 45 held-out prompts (18 classification, 26 extraction, 1 tool selection); 4 train and 5 test decode states per prompt
random_seed: 1301 primary; 1302 training-seed replication; split seed 20261013 robustness

modeled_bytes: selector metadata plus executed final-layer MLP payload = 91.526852% of dense layer payload; 8.473148% analytic margin before dispatch/coalescing overhead
detector_overhead: resident selector parameters = 2.053168% of final-layer MLP parameters; PyTorch hook still executes the dense MLP
confidence_interval: primary 225-state split: top1 1.0/KL 0.00644; seed 1302: 1.0/0.00641; split seed 20261013: 0.99556/0.00714. No statistical interval; two training seeds and two shuffled splits.
result: passed the preregistered synthetic-enterprise causal gate. Primary exact five-token free-running agreement was 1.0 across 45 held-out prompts. Static train-energy and random-fixed controls failed at top1/KL 0.98667/0.02408 and 0.83556/0.13155. The varied default 20/20 corpus also failed at 0.92/0.01782, so the result is workload-specific and nonphysical.
next_action: Freeze the configuration and test an independently sourced corpus, longer rollouts, FP32, a third training seed, task parsers, and whole-model overhead before implementing a fused block-sparse kernel.
